reviews.text:
Very pleased with service from Quality Tops Roofing! No high pressure or coercion to get more than I needed. Responded promptly to my inquiries, explained details of work to be done and pricing explained to my understanding, then work completed as planned. No problems with anyone on their teams.
Would definitely use them again and highly recommend them to others.

I've known Bruce and his family since I was a kid, and I wouldn't use anyone else for my roof and gutter needs. Bruce was so great helping me navigate the painful process of dealing with my insurance company, and he was so patient with me. Absolutely recommend!

Bruce Sabine and his excellent, professional crew completed our roof in a short period of time and gave us the best, possible price. We have used this company in the past and appreciate his integrity and professionalism. His company has the best reputation in the area and stands behind their work. I highly recommend this company!

During the recent hail storm, the top of my pergola was severely damaged. I called Bruce at Quality Tops Roofing since they had replaced my house roof 4 year ago and did an excellent job. Bruce gave me a very fair price using quality materials and his crew did a wonderful job. My pergola looks brand new and his team is very professional from start to finish. For any roofing replacement or repairs, I will only be using Quality Tops Roofing. Thank you, Bruce and your crew for always providing the

This is my second time working with Bruce and Tim at Quality Tops Roofing. They replaced my roof in 2014 and again after our recent hail storms.  They are fair, honest, detailed, and truly strive to make sure the customer is satisfied and the work is done right.  We had a few minor issues with the installation, but Tim was very helpful and thorough in getting all the issues resolved.  Highly recommend this company to anyone needing a new roof or roof repairs.

I recently had a roof leak that due to a family emergency needed immediate attention.  I called Quality Tops Roofing who I had used in the past and they literally “jumped through hoops” to help me.  Not only did they fix my issue the same day they did an outstanding job at a very good price.  I highly recommend Quality Tops Roofing.  They are truly the best!

I had an aging roof and my homeowners insurance annual premium reflected it. After having several quotes from other reputable companies I chose Quality Tops Roofing. The reason was several factors, Bruce was very knowledgeable and walked me through the entire process and made it so understandable. I wasn’t given the full court press sales pitch. Everything was clear and the price was very fair. Tim and his crew installed the roof in one day while I was at work, when I came home, I wouldn’t have

This is the 3rd time that I've used Quality Tops over the last, I guess, 25 years.  They are everything that you would want in a Roofing company. They do Quality work from start to finish. Many of their employees have been with them for over 10 to 20+ years, so you can trust that they will be around to stand behind their work. They will take you through a worry free experience.  Trust me,  you too will be a repeat customer!

I have used Quality Tops Roofing on 3 occasions over the last 8 years to perform roofing inspections and repairs.  I have always found them to be prompt, professional and honest.  The inspectors have accurately identified my roofing problems and the crews have correctly fixed the issues on each occasion.  I would certainly use them again in the future and I would not hesitate to recommend them to others.

I have used Quality Tops Roofing twice-- last year for a minor roof repair and this year for a complete roof replacement. Both times, they were very professional and responsive. They provided clear explanations of their proposals and alternatives. They are an excellent roofing company and I highly recommend them for any size roof work.

Quality Tops Roofing did a fantastic job at my home. They identified a problem ignored by others, explained it, and fixed it! They did not try to up-sell, but did the roof repairs needed to protect my home at a fair price.  The initial inspector was thorough in his evaluation and informative in explaining what was needed. Workers were courteous and thoroughly cleaned up the work area at job completion. I recommend Quality Tops for roof repairs and/or replacements.

I wanted to write this review because of the EXCELLENT service and response I received from Quality Tops Roofing. I worked with Bruce who was their field Representative Supervisor. He was an Fantastic easy going gentlemen who, after explaining my predicament to him, was able to provide a concise solution and was able to explain it to both my wife and i making a complex situation an easy remedy to repair. As I explained to him we had another contractor do work that was unsatisfactory resulting in

Quality Tops won my business in several ways: price, approach, terms, and materials. They were not afraid to compete vs several other vendors on Good Contractors. They came in with a better proposal all the way round, incl my concerns about venting, and worked with me as to delays caused by the mortgage servicer. Roof is beautiful match to the house and is using hail resistant tiles.

Quality Tops Roofing was referred to us from our Realtor. The team responded quickly to our needs to get the roof repaired soon after our purchase, as required by our lender and home insurer. They did a great jobbing matching and everything was cleaned up so well you couldn't tell there was ever a problem. I'm happy to recommend them.

The owner Bruce and his guys are very responsive and very good. Have called on them three times over the years, most recently in August to replace an aging and insanely noisy roof turbine. The job, which involved locating a matching turbine and then installing, was completed literally the next day. Highly recommend!

Quality Tops Roofing exemplifies their leading name "Quality".  As an architect I am pretty picky of who I want to work on my properties.  After my review of local contractors and choosing them to do a full roof replacement of my rental house they were very professional and worked with my insurance carrier that made the whole process quick and simple.

I liked their work so much that I hired them again to do a repair on my primary residence and again it went flawlessly.  I look forward to using

We needed to get our roof replaced within a 2 week timeframe so I called Quality Tops Roofing and Bruce came out and gave us an estimate. He told me they could do it within 2 weeks even though they were very busy and sure enough our roof was done within 10 days. Awesome company to work with. They are fast, honest, reliable and their price was very reasonable. We are very pleased with the new roof. I will recommend them to friends and use them again for our roofing needs.

Quality Tops Roofing is unlike what you normally find in any construction trade. They were prompt, professional, fair and honest. Their way of doing business will make you comfortable with the process and leave you feeling important and valued. If you have a roofing need, we would highly recommend Quality Tops!

After doing a good amount of research, my next-door neighbor had Quality Tops replace his roof and was very satisfied. They did a fine job on my replacement roof too. I did have to reschedule several times due to some health issues, and they were quite accommodating. Luckily it was finished just before the record February rainstorms and I'm happy to report my new roof passed that test. I can certainly recommend Quality Tops without reservation.

Quality tops roofing is the best. They worked with my insurance and got everything I needed done. After they came out and finished my roof, my neighbors even commented on the crews cleanliness and how efficient they were compared to the people my neighbors used. The efficiency and quality really shows how great this company is. I recommend them to all my family and friends.

Quality Tops did a high-quality job for us at a very fair price.  A Quality Tops representative provided our estimate earlier than we had scheduled. When they were on site, the roofing crew communicated with us throughout the process and did a superior job on the roof. After their work was done, a Quality Tops representative conducted a quality assurance review to finish up the job. Excellent work! We will definitely use Quality Tops again in the future.

We moved to the Dallas area in 1982. Shortly thereafter we learned that this part of Texas has major hail storms about every 5 to 7 years.  Quality Tops Roofing has replaced a total of 8 roofs for us since arriving to Texas in 1982. Their professionalism and work ethic and honesty are perfect. We have never had an issue with any of our 8 roofs.  No matter how long we may live in Texas when we need a new roof Quality Tops Roofing will be our only choice.

I first used Quality Tops Roofing over 10 years ago when I had the roof replaced on my home, garage, and patio. The installation was not without missteps, but Bruce's dedication to get it right and make sure I was 100% satisfied is not only why I have referred them to every single person who asks for a roofer recommendation but also why I have had them come inspect my roof after big storms and had them repair my garage when a neighbor's tree fell on it. You won't find a more fair, honest, and re

Quality Tops replaced the roofs on both my home and backyard workshop. They were professional, courteous and honest. Best of all, the quality of their work was top notch and priced fairly. I would recommend this company to anyone in need of roof repair.

This was the third time Quality Tops has installed a roof on a house for me. I have been happy with the work every time. Even though I have been satisfied with their work, I bid out the jobs with other contractors and Quality Tops pricing is always competitive. They are the first company I contact for roofing needs.

Three years ago, I had them replace my roof. I found them via The Good Contractors List. Their estimate was reasonable, so I hired them. Before they replaced the roof, they did a beautiful job of repairing the facia boards. They did a very good job of installing my new roof. Last month, a storm caused a large tree branch to crunch into one of my gables. It also put a hole in my roof. They did a temporary repair to prevent any further damage.  They procured shingles that match the other shingles,

These guys were professional and respectful of my property. Bruce came out and looked at my roof and followed up when he said he would with an estimate. He took time to answer all my questions and concerns. The repair crew was prompt, courteous and like roofing ninjas- they didn’t leave any trace! I received a follow up call to make sure I was satisfied with the service. I highly recommend Quality Tops Roofing, the quality customer service definitely stands out!

The only roofing company that told me the price of the roof job without asking for the insurance quotes first.  They have done my roof twice and would recommend to anyone.  Quality roof job at a fair price.

I recently had the pleasure of working with an exceptional roofing company, and I couldn’t be happier. They walked me through the process, explained everything in detail, and offered unbeatable pricing. Their quality of work is top-notch, and I highly recommend them.

I have been doing business with Quality Tops for a long time.  I think I've had them replace my roof twice, but I could be mistaken about that.  They do good work, but you can say that about many firms.  The real reason I still stick with them is this: I can trust them.  It seems that almost every roofer will advise you that your roof needs to be replaced if a hailstone has hit it; oddly enough, the insurance adjusters most of the time don't push back.  But Quality Tops will shoot straight, and

The Quality Tops Roofing personnel that I did business with were very knowledgeable,
friendly, and took care of the replacement of my roof with competency and speed. I first used their service when I was looking for a company to replace a few shingles and they had no problem taking care of the small job. I feel sure that I have a quality roof and if a problem does arise that Quality Tops Roofing with be there for me with a solution.

I had hail damage and needed a new roof. My insurance company was being a pain but Quality Tops roofing worked with me and the insurance company to get it done. I went with the high impact roof and Quality Tops did a great job. Quality Tops has been around a long time and do a great job and back their work. I highly recommend them.

I had a good experience with Quality Tops. Bruce went into detailed explanations about his approach to the job, and about improving the attic ventilation as part of the re-roof. He recommended impact resistance shingles, etc.  They communicated well during the job and corrected minor issues brought to their attention.  The roof looks good.

As a homeowner, roof repairs can seem overwhelming, so we are tremendously grateful to work with Quality Tops Roofing on any and all roof related needs. The company was referred by a work colleague when we first bought our home five years ago, and we have used Quality Tops Roofing (and no other roofing company) since then. They have performed minor shingle repairs and re-caulking around attic vents every year (Texas sun and storms is brutal on roofs!), as well as installation of new wind turbine

My Mom had a 50 foot tree blow down and barely hit her house. Quality Tops Roofing had installed her roof a number of years ago. When I called the phone number on her receipt I was happy they were still in business. They took down her information and came by the next day to have a look at the damage. It was a small job (thank goodness), and quality tops had all the repairs done in a week. Everyone was so helpful and polite, and it seemed they really wanted to do a good job. The repairs look grea

Quality Tops Roofing repaired a leak in our roof around a vent.  They also did some preventive work, so that our other vents would not leak in the future.  All for a very reasonable price.  When it comes time to replace our roof, we will definitely call Quality Tops.

Quality Tops Roofing has to be one of the most professional companies we have ever dealt with. Bruce came out and gave us a bid, answered all our questions and we never felt pressured to make a decision. We were kept informed during the scheduling delays due to rain and when the day finally came to have the job done, the crew was outstanding. Bruce came out for a roof inspection back in 2014. He installed the roof in 2014. We found a leak in November of this year 2020. Bruce came out & looked at the roof, found where the leak was it was the boards under the shingles. He sent his crew out to repair at his cost even thought the shingles were fine & the workmanship was out of warranty by almost 3 years. When his crew got out here & found the original problem for the leak was not his fault, they still repaired at no cost to me. I would u

Several roof caps were blowen off my roof due to the high winds in our area of Mansfield. Quality Tops Roofing repaired my roof quickly and professionally. The next couple of days we had thunderstorms with 20+ mph wind gusts. Once the  weather subsided I could see the true quality of their work. I recommend Quality Tops Roofing to both my family and friends for any and all future roof repairs. Paul keep up the great work.

Despite the hail damage and age of our roof the estimator told me I could probably get another year out of our roof before replacing. For me that spoke volumes as to the integrity of this company. Went on to get the roof anyways and they did a fine job, cleaned up well (which cant be said for many roofers) and followed up with a quality inspection. Very satisfied with performance and price..

I was very pleased with my interaction with the Quality Tops team. Their CEO Bruce was patient and transparent in helping us figure out how to replace a weather-damaged roof and gutters. He worked with us to get the best value for our insurance adjustment. They were able to get started soon after the damage, theiir roofing team was excellent in workmanship and they finished in good time. They were great on cleanup and took care not to damage our ornamentals. Gutter work was subcontracted. They d

I have used Quality Tops as a homeowner several times in repairing my own roof, removing a skylight, adding and replacing attic venting, etc.  I am a REALTOR®  as well and know the importance of a professional, honest and trustworthy roofing company that delivers an affordable product and exceptional service.  I highly recommend Quality Tops Roofing for all your roofing needs.

Great service at a great price. Bruce was very good at acknowledging the problems with the roof and telling us what would suit it best. When I asked about a ridge vent he could have said sure and charged me for it, but instead he explained that the way my attic is ventilated a ridge vent would not work efficiently and would end up being a waste of money. Its always refreshing to not be forced to buy the bells and whistles when you don't need them. I will be using Quality Tops Roofing for all my

I had a few shingles blown away by strong winds. They responded quickly and did the repairs quickly also. It was a small job so their minimum rate applied. I understand that and my deductible would have been more anyway. Hope I don't have any more roof problems, but if I do I will definitely call them again.

We selected Quality Tops Roofing as a local business for our roof replacement. They offered competitive pricing and did a great job. I was most fascinated of how quickly they had the job done. It took them one day to complete my 2 story 3000+ sqft home. They cleaned up well and we are very satisfied with their service. Thanks guys for a job well done.

On October 20 2019, the Dallas tornado fell two trees damaging our roof, gutters, and more.  After lengthy negotiations with the insurance company we were able to get the funds for repairs in June 2020.

We were seeking a company to repair the roof as well as the gutters. After talking to acquaintances and much research, we were able to narrow the list to 3 well respected companies. All three companies came to observe the damage and provided a professional quote.

I requested a quote from Quality Tops Roofing based on the recommendation of a TRUSTED acquaintance who has provided residential services for my home for over 10 years.  The recommendation was based on personal experience and it was spot on.  Quality Tops Roofing provide not only an estimate, but options with pros/cons of each. This is the second time I've had Quality Tops Roofing give me a new roof (Thanks Texas Hail!).  The first time, I had just bought a new home and it was in desperate need of a new roof.  As a brand new homeowner, they were patient and their pricing was extremely fair.

I have had the pleasure of dealing with this company for several years now. First experience was several years ago when they replaced my roof following a hail storm.Their pricing has always been very competitive and the quality of work has always been exceptional. I have referred them to a number of friends over the years.  I don't shop for roofers anymore.  When I need work done I just call Quality Tops.

Quality Tops Roofing replaced our roof more than ten years ago, and did an outstanding job. They were very professional and a pleasure to work with.  The roof and shingles have performed wonderfully. Last year, we had a different company come to remove a bee hive in the soffit of the back porch, which later led to water penetrating into our bedroom.
